verdict.rationale: Docusign exposes agreement status, key dates, and metadata plus workflow-triggering actions via its REST API and the Claude MCP connector (docusign-docs-11, docusign-docs-37, docusign-docs-36, docusign-probe-3), which could let an agent monitor and act on renewals/deadlines.
